1651-3875-5921-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-3875-5921-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-3875-5921-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

618-1916-2511.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1170-4030-5131-6798--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4030-5131-6798--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Starnheim Courser.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-4094-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

280-2248-7857.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

2511-2946-4871-6026.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2511-2946-4871-6026.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-3054-5346-6809.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Crime Novelist and Scion of Opulence trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Scion of Opulence trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

3705-5231-5997-7729.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa and The Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Iraxxa trigger, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2263-2292-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
2263-2292-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

757-2026-3094.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

1445-1913-2921-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1913-2921-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers if the creature that was returned to your hand was an artifact, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2308-4506-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4506-4871-5231.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Auriok Champion triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1329-3338-4985-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

717-2628-4652--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Bone Miser's second ability trigger.
Resolve Bone Miser's ability, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Tilling Treefolk.
When Tilling Treefolk enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land and up to one additional land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
717-2628-4652--38.notes: You can discard down to maximum hand size at end of turn to trigger Bone Miser's abilities many times.

1978-4131-4241.description:
Animate Basalt Monolith using Karn.
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-3991-6132.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more +1/+1 counters on it

645-2034-2060-3750-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2034-2060-3750-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer, adding {C}{C}.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

2034-4268-4593-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-4268-4593-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

4067-5527-5672.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
4067-5527-5672.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Clues.
4067-5527-5672.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1274-3490-4659-4716.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4659-4716.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

4869-5636-6092.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
4869-5636-6092.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

with a takeover counter on it

4050-5326--5--6.notablePrerequisites:
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of either the persist or undying creature.
The Master does not have a +1/+1 counter on it if it is a copy of the undying creature, or a -1/-1 counter on it otherwise.
4050-5326--5--6.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Master, adding one mana of any color.
When The Master dies, if it was a copy of the undying creature, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the persist creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Otherwise, if The Master was a copy of the persist creature, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the undying creature with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

687-2438-3220-5004.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three counters among creatures you control.
687-2438-3220-5004.description:
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, it and Golgari Germination trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token that enters the battlefield with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Tayam ability from step 1, causing you to mill three cards and return Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat.

4302-4509-4619.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three white Angels.
4302-4509-4619.description:
Activate Teysa by sacrificing three Angels, targeting any creature.
When the Angels die, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers three times.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Teysa abilities, exiling the chosen creature(s).
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

203-565-974.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
203-565-974.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Anoint with buyback by paying {3}{W}, targeting the Smaug token.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put the new Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve Anoint from step 2, returning it to your hand.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{W}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature(s) you control using Anoint, to create infinite tokens of them using Orvar.

1823-2484.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a creature with toughness less than 13.
1823-2484.description:
Cast Blasphemous Act by paying at most {7}{R}, dealing 13 damage to each creature.
For each creature opponents control that is dealt excess damage, Fall of Cair Andros triggers, creating a 0/0 Army if you dont control one, and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on an Army you control equal to the excess damage.

205-215.description:
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Azor from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Azor by paying {2}{W}{W}{U}{U}.
Azor enters the battlefield, preventing opponents from casting instants or sorceries during their next turn.
Repeat each turn.

240-439-643-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign, adding one mana of any color.
Arashin Sovereign dies, triggering itself and Atla Palani.
Resolve the Arashin Sovereign trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Atla Palani trigger, revealing Arashin Sovereign from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1283-3094-4647-4853-5147.description:
Cast Dross Scorpion for {4}.
With Dross Scorpion on the stack, use Lithoform Engine to copy the spell, using Chromatic Orrery to pay for Lithoform Engine.
Let the copy of Dross Scorpion resolve.
Sacrifice Dross Scorpion to Goblin Bombardment, Dealing 1 damage to any target.
Dross Scorpion triggers twice due to Teysa Karlov.
untap Lithoform Engine and Chromatic Orrery with the Dross Scorpion triggers.
Repeat steps 2-6.

147-3505-5256.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
